Name: Custom Seasonings
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[u][b][size=5]Overview[/size][/b][/u]

This mod acts as a framework to create custom seasonings, and allow choosing a seasoning (or none) when cooking any dish.

Dish names may be altered to indicate the presence of seasoning (e.g. Ginger Salad for a salad with ginger as a seasoning), and seasoning may apply a tint to the dish's colour.

Seasoning can change a dish's buff granularly or by setting a quality like Qi Seasoning.

Dishes without buffs can now give buffs when seasoned.

Note that this mod will not work with cooking overhaul mods that replace the vanilla cooking menu, but they are welcome to implement a compatible system and use this mod's code if they want, and there is a C# API available.

[/list]
[u][b][size=5]Creating Custom Seasoning[/size][/b][/u]

Using Content Patcher, target [b]"aedenthorn.CustomSeasoning/dict"[/b], e.g.:

[code]{
    "Format": "2.7.0",
    "Changes": [
        {
            "Action": "EditData",
            "Target": "aedenthorn.CustomSeasoning/dict",
            "Entries": {
                "{{ModId}}.RockSalt": {
                    "BuffData": {
                        "MiningLevel": 1
                    },
                    "ChangedName": "{{i18n:rocksalt.change}}",
                    "Tint": {
                        "R": 255,
                        "G": 192,
                        "B": 203
                    },
                   "TintAlpha": 0.1
               },
                "{{ModId}}.Qi": {
                    "ChangedName": "{{i18n:qi.name}}",
                    "Quality": 4
                },
                "829": {
                    "BuffData": {
                        "CriticalChanceMultiplier": 1
                    },
                    "DurationMultiplier": 2,
                   "BaseDuration": 1200,
                    "ChangedName": "{{i18n:ginger.change}}"
                }
            }
        }
    ]
}[/code]
The dictionary keys are the unqualified item id of the seasoning, either a modded item or a vanilla item.

[b]ChangedName [/b]should be something like "Ginger {0}" and the {0} will be replaced with the original dish name.

[b]Quality [/b]affects the dish just as Qi Seasoning does (Qi Seasoning gives dishes a quality of 2).

[b]BuffData[/b] uses the same structure as [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Objects]the vanilla Buffs->CustomAttributes field[/url].

[b]BaseDuration[/b] is used if the seasoning is applied to food that doesn't normally provide any buffs (default is 600 if omitted).


[u][b][size=5]Technical[/size][/b][/u]

Requires SMAPI.

Translations should use config variable names as the keys, adding .Desc to the end of the key for hover descriptions.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
